messages:
julie: FYI i walked a new hire through the python quickstart and hit two separate gotchas that tripped them up in ~15 minutes

julie: first: the README snippet uses `Redwood_Api_Key` (mixed-case) when everywhere else we reference `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. they copied it verbatim and auth failed with a vague `AuthenticationError`.

marc: oof. env var casing is subtle across OS/CI. windows ignores case, linux/mac do not. which file was it in?

julie: docs/quickstarts/python/quickstart.md — top-level example code block. i checked the SDK: it reads `os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")`. i think someone pasted a handwritten example into the md and used different casing.

zane: second thing?

julie: the async sample shows: 
```
# in quickstart (async section)
from redwood import RedwoodClient

client = RedwoodClient()

async def main():
    resp = await client.generate("hi")
    print(resp.text)

# run
import asyncio
asyncio.run(main())
```

julie: that pattern doesn't initialize the async transport's background retry/backoff state. our async client expects either `async with RedwoodClient()` or `await client.connect()` before calling streaming/generate to ensure retries and reconnects work. without it retries silently don't happen and transient 502/503s bubble out.

marc: ah interesting. so the sample gives false confidence that `retry=True` will work for ephemeral calls.

zane: can reproduce quickly. `await client.generate(..., retry=True)` without enter/connect -> first request fails on transient 503. `async with` fixes it.

peter: can we update docs + add a unit for snippet-lint that asserts the exact env var literal? i can add a small regex check in tools/snippet-lint to fail if docs show `Redwood_Api_Key` or any case-variant.

marc: please also add a short note inline: "for long-running apps use async with / connect to manage background resources (retries, backoff)". a one-liner near the example should be enough.

docs-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/issues/4720 capturing: (1) quickstart env var casing mismatch, (2) async sample missing context manager/connect, (3) add snippet-lint check.

peter: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5158 updating quickstart.md, switching examples to `os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")` and replacing the async example with `async with` pattern + inline note. added lint test under tools/snippet-lint/test_env_var.sh.

zane: can we also drop a short blurb about windows vs unix env var behavior and CI/docker gotchas? saves future questions.

peter: added a one-paragraph note and linked the platform docs.

julie: can we backport to `v1.x-docs`? some customers pin that branch for onboarding.

docs-bot: backport PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5160 (v1.x-docs).

julie: awesome thanks everyone. will re-run the intern onboarding checklist tomorrow and close the loop. :thumbsup:
